title: Red Lead Skillet
subtitle: Senior cook specialty—steak, peppers, and eggs in one cast-iron pan.
description: The official Red Lead sauce folded into a breakfast hash with potatoes, sausage, and eggs. Station signature flavor — crew-approved and hall-authentic.

ingredients.name: steak seasoning
ingredients.notes: or equal parts salt, pepper, garlic powder

steps.title: Par-cook the potatoes
steps.instruction: Microwave diced potatoes with a splash of water in a covered bowl until just tender. Drain well and pat dry so the skillet gets crust instead of steam.

steps.title: Sear steak strips
steps.instruction: Heat cast iron over high with oil until shimmering (about 400°F surface). Sear steak in batches without crowding, 2–3 minutes per side, until deeply browned and internal temperature reaches 130°F for medium-rare strips. Rest on a warm tray while you build the base.

steps.title: Crisp potatoes and peppers
steps.instruction: Add more oil to the pan, then potatoes in a single layer. Let them sit 3 minutes for color, toss, then add onion and peppers. Cook over medium-high until charred at the edges.

steps.title: Combine and make wells
steps.instruction: Fold steak back into the skillet. Make shallow wells across the surface and crack an egg into each well. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cover and finish
steps.instruction: Cover with a lid or inverted sheet pan over medium-low heat until egg whites are fully set (165°F) and yolks are runny or jammy to your crew's preference. Scatter cheese, cover 60 seconds to melt, and serve straight from the pan.

stationWorkflow: Assign one cook to the cast iron and one to toast or warm plates so service doesn't stall when eggs finish.
Sear steak in batches before the crew lines up—hold sliced on a warm tray covered loosely with foil.
Serve family-style from the skillet or portion onto warm plates immediately; eggs wait for no one.
cleanupNotes: Deglaze the cast iron with hot water while still warm, then scrape with a chain-mail scrubber once cooled enough to handle safely.
Wipe cutting boards and knives immediately after raw steak prep to avoid cross-contamination during egg service.
leftovers: Reheat potato-steak base covered at 325°F for 10 minutes; fry fresh eggs to order rather than reheating set yolks.
Chop leftovers into breakfast burrito filling with hot sauce and shredded cheese for the next shift.
